displayName: Force WebSQL in non-secure contexts to be enabled (Obsolete)
description:
This policy doesn't work because WebSQL in nonsecure contexts is on by default as of Microsoft Edge 105.
If you enable this policy, WebSQL in nonsecure contexts is enabled.
If you disable or don't configure this policy, WebSQL in nonsecure contexts follows the default settings of the browser.

This policy was removed in Microsoft Edge 113, and it's ignored if configured.
